definitions.explanation: how something or someone appears on the surface, often implying it may differ from reality

examples.japanese: {見掛|みか}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧よらず{優|やさ}しい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He's a kind person, despite appearances.

examples.japanese: {見掛|みか}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: He looks scary, but he has a warm heart.

examples.japanese: {見掛|みか}け⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}して→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't judge people by appearances alone.

notes:
USAGE:
- {見掛|みか}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧よらず (contrary to appearances)
- {見掛|みか}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜 (in appearance...)
- {見掛|みか}け⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧ (only in appearance)
- {見掛|みか}け{倒|だお}し (all show, no substance)
Often implies a contrast between appearance and reality. The phrase {見掛|みか}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧よらず is very common and means "contrary to what you'd expect from their appearance."

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{外見|がいけん}→外見：12114_gaiken⟧ (outward appearance - more formal)
- ⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧ (visual appearance)
- ⟦{容姿|ようし}→容姿：12293_youshi⟧ (physical appearance)
